title: Southern New Hampshire University (SNHU)
summary: Southern New Hampshire University (SNHU) is a university in Manchester. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with SNHU.

sections.heading: What SNHU is known for
paragraphs: Southern New Hampshire University (SNHU) is recognized for its large undergraduate enrollment, with over 163,000 students. The university operates as a private nonprofit institution, according to College Scorecard ownership data. SNHU is known for its strong emphasis on business education, with approximately 35.09% of its programs focused in this area. Additionally, health-related programs constitute about 7.56% of the university's offerings. The institution has a notably high admission rate of 99.51%, reflecting its inclusive enrollment policies.

sections.heading: Key strengths
paragraphs: Southern New Hampshire University (SNHU) is a private nonprofit institution, as classified by College Scorecard ownership data. One of its key strengths lies in its diverse program offerings, with a notable emphasis on health-related fields, which make up approximately 7.56% of its academic programs. Education programs represent a smaller portion, accounting for about 0.1% of the total. This distribution highlights SNHU's commitment to providing a range of academic options, particularly in health disciplines.

SNHU's admissions approach reflects its commitment to offering educational opportunities to a broad range of applicants.

sections.heading: How to read SNHU tuition
paragraphs: Southern New Hampshire University (SNHU) charges a tuition rate of $17,200 for both in-state and out-of-state students. This uniform tuition fee simplifies the cost structure regardless of residency status. However, the total cost of attendance at SNHU is higher, amounting to $40,918. This figure includes additional expenses beyond tuition, such as fees, housing, meals, books, and personal costs. Understanding these distinctions is important for prospective students when evaluating the overall financial commitment required to attend SNHU.

sections.heading: Financial aid
paragraphs: Southern New Hampshire University (SNHU) offers financial aid options to support students in managing the cost of attendance. Approximately 48.75% of SNHU students receive Pell Grants, which are federal subsidies aimed at assisting low-income students. For those who complete their programs, the median debt incurred is $21,082, reflecting the typical borrowing amount among graduates. Prospective students can explore detailed financial aid information and use net price calculators available on SNHU's official website at www.snhu.edu/ and the College Scorecard page at https://collegescorecard.ed.gov/school/?183026 to better understand potential costs and aid opportunities.

paragraphs: Southern New Hampshire University (SNHU) provides housing options for students both on and off campus. The estimated cost for room and board on campus is approximately $12,800. For students who choose to live off campus, the combined expenses for housing and meals are higher, averaging around $14,252. These figures reflect the typical living costs associated with attending SNHU and are important considerations for students planning their budgets.

sections.heading: Manchester and the SNHU campus
paragraphs: Southern New Hampshire University (SNHU) is located in Manchester, New Hampshire, within the 03106 zip code area. The SNHU campus is situated in this city, providing students with access to the resources and amenities of Manchester. As a city in New Hampshire, Manchester serves as the home for SNHU's main campus, contributing to the university's community and environment.

sections.heading: Career outcomes
paragraphs: Southern New Hampshire University (SNHU) reports a completion rate within 150% of the expected time at approximately 42.83%. Graduates of SNHU have median earnings of $41,945 six years after enrollment, which increase to $50,318 ten years after enrollment. Among those who complete their programs, the median debt incurred is $21,082. These figures provide insight into the financial outcomes and career trajectories of SNHU students following their education.
